questions.question: Which West African empire became wealthy through trans-Saharan trade in gold and salt?
choices: Byzantine Empire
Mali Empire
Inca Empire
Mughal Empire

questions.question: Who was Mansa Musa, ruler of Mali, known for in the fourteenth century?
choices: Founding the city of Constantinople
Leading the first voyage around Africa
His pilgrimage to Mecca and the display of Mali's wealth
Writing the Justinian Code

questions.question: Why were salt and gold important in trans-Saharan trade?
choices: They were the only goods traded in Africa
Gold was used only as decoration
Salt could not be preserved or transported
They were valuable goods exchanged across regions with different resources

questions.question: Which African kingdom was centered in present-day Zimbabwe and known for monumental stone structures?
choices: Great Zimbabwe
Aksum
Benin
Kongo

questions.question: The Swahili Coast connected East African cities to
choices: the trans-Pacific fur trade
Indian Ocean trade networks
the Viking routes of the Baltic Sea
the Inca road system

questions.question: What was one role of griots in some West African societies?
choices: They served as Roman emperors
They built irrigation canals in the Andes
They preserved and shared histories, genealogies, and cultural knowledge
They controlled every trans-Saharan caravan

questions.question: Why did the Niger River support settlement and trade in West Africa?
choices: It isolated all inland communities
It prevented farming near its banks
It connected directly to the Mediterranean Sea
It provided water and transportation across parts of the region

questions.question: Which early African kingdom developed around the Red Sea trade routes and adopted Christianity in the fourth century?
choices: Aksum
Songhai
Great Zimbabwe
Benin

questions.question: Timbuktu became an important center in Mali and Songhai partly because it
choices: was a major port on the Indian Ocean
connected trade and scholarship in the trans-Saharan network
stood at the source of the Amazon River
served as the Byzantine capital

questions.question: How did the spread of Islam affect some West African states?
choices: It made every African society culturally identical
It ended trade across the Sahara
It influenced scholarship, trade, and political life while local practices and traditions continued
It replaced all existing languages immediately

questions.question: Which statement about African geography is most accurate?
choices: The entire continent is covered by rainforest
The Sahara is the only significant geographic feature
All African societies developed in the same way
The continent contains diverse climates, environments, and settlement patterns

questions.question: Why did control of trade routes strengthen some African states?
choices: It could provide revenue, political influence, and access to valuable goods
It eliminated the need for agriculture
It guaranteed permanent peace
It made neighboring regions unable to trade

questions.question: Which material is most closely associated with the surviving architecture of Great Zimbabwe?
choices: Concrete poured by Roman engineers
Dry-stone masonry
Carved marble from the Alps
Timber imported from Scandinavia

questions.question: A historian studies coastal East African city-states that traded with Arabia, Persia, India, and China. Which network is most relevant?
choices: Trans-Saharan trade only
Silk Road across Central Asia only
Indian Ocean trade
Atlantic triangular trade

questions.question: What role did the Songhai Empire play in West African history?
choices: It ruled the Andes from Cusco
It created the Byzantine legal code
It controlled the Nile Delta throughout antiquity
It expanded power and trade along parts of the Niger and trans-Saharan routes

questions.question: Why do historians use oral traditions alongside written documents and archaeology?
choices: They can preserve perspectives and histories not fully represented in written sources
Oral traditions are always identical and unchanging
They replace the need to evaluate evidence
They provide exact dates for every event

questions.question: Benin City is historically associated with which West African kingdom known for artistic bronze and brass works?
choices: Mali Empire
Kingdom of Benin
Aksumite Empire
Kingdom of Kush

questions.question: How did camel caravans help trans-Saharan trade expand?
choices: Camels made deserts permanently fertile
Caravans eliminated the need for trade centers
Camels could travel long distances in arid environments while carrying goods
Camels connected the Atlantic directly to China

questions.question: A community produces iron tools and trades them with neighboring farmers. What does this show?
choices: Trade occurs only between empires
Iron tools prevented agriculture
Every community produced identical goods
Specialized production and exchange linked different communities

questions.question: Why is it important to name specific African societies rather than describe all of Africa as one civilization?
choices: Distinct societies had different histories, institutions, and environments
The continent had no long-distance connections
All societies used the same political system
Regional differences began only in the twentieth century
